determination_points: All models in use are on record, the fields are complete, and there is no unregistered production call
There are difficulty tiering rules, and high-frequency simple requests do not go to the flagship model by default
For any one historical answer picked at random, the model and version actually hit can be found
A critical path has a backup model or a degradation path, and a recent drill or an actual triggering is on record
An automatic switching scenario has an acceptable scope confirmed by the business side, or has been changed to fail explicitly
The most recent version change has an entry in the MOD register, and a baseline re-evaluation was done after the change
The evaluation report attaches the judge model version and the scoring rubric version, and changes to either carry a breakpoint mark
Model costs can be exported by team and by project, and anomalous consumption can land on a specific caller
There is a check step before content produced by the model itself is written back to memory and knowledge carriers, and instructional content does not directly become a rule
A go-live scenario has a written capability boundary statement, and none of the four outsourced classes of responsibility has been handed to the model by default
For any one sampled historical task, the decomposition result and the assignment decisions can be reconstructed
The four caps on steps, retries, duration, and consumption are configured and in effect
Subtasks have completion and failure criteria, and the failure action is predetermined
A human confirmation point stands before irreversible and high risk steps, and the executor does not serve as its own confirmer
The assignment scope does not exceed the delimitation by Access Control, and there is no equivalent bypass path after interception

check_item: The subordinate does not exceed the superior
determination_points: The sub agent's permissions, data scope, and step cap have none exceeded its superior
Multi agent division of labor, handover format, and conflict adjudication have a registered text
For a running task, the state of any subtask and the most recent decision can be queried
Failure task records contain the cause, the actions already executed, and the handling result, with no silent swallowing
Freeze and conflict signals can trigger a stop and re-verification, with trigger records available for checking
The tools in use are all on record, the fields are complete, and there is no unregistered call path
The parameter by parameter explanations are complete, and description changes have version and regression records
Noncompliant input parameters are intercepted and clearly reported, with no dirty parameters passed through

check_item: Read and write grading is true
determination_points: The three grade registration matches the actual attribute, and no destructive write is registered at a lowered grade
Before the five classes of action are executed there are scope confirmation, release, and a recovery path
Non idempotent tools have deduplication protection, retry has a cap, and at the cap failure is returned truthfully
Going live and upgrades have source and integrity verification records
New tools and major version changes have rehearsal validation records
Returns distinguish success, partial success, and failure and attach a basis, with no fabrication
For any one sampled call, the tool, input parameter summary, executor, and result can be reconstructed
All three categories of carrier are on record, with location, reading and writing parties, and periods complete
Before long-term memory and shared memory are written, there is a source and category inspection
Any one item of long-term memory drawn at random can be traced to its source, channel, and write time
Reading and writing across users, across tasks, and across agents is blocked, and there are verification records
Each category of memory has a period and an expiry handling, and there is no carrier with indefinite retention
Deletion execution covers derived carriers such as summaries and distillations, and leaves a record
Instructional content in memory has not been directly executed as an execution rule
Task summaries and session summaries have batch sampling inspection records
For any one session drawn at random, the list of memory injected on that occasion can be produced
Memory items in conflict with the Knowledge layer have been marked expired and injection has stopped, with no two accounts in parallel
Documents within the retrieval scope are on record item by item, with fields complete

check_item: Version currently in force is single
determination_points: For the same rule only one version currently in force is in supply, and the old version has exited retrieval
Expired documents have been marked pending re-verification, withdrawn documents have been taken offline and their vectors cleared
Any one knowledge answer drawn at random can be pointed back to a fragment number, version, and date
When retrieval has no result, no result is clearly returned, with no fragments used to make up the numbers
Chunking and index changes have version registration and regression test records
External, uploaded, and self-produced materials have review records before intake, and the isolation zone and the formal zone are separated
There is no record or channel of an internal file being sent outside the boundary, and agent behavior is subject to the same constraint
Retrieval results carry the classification level and scope, and fragments beyond authority are not supplied
Erroneous knowledge can be located by fragment and index and correction completed, with a ledger record
Person, agent, and service identities and credentials are all on record, with no credential of unknown origin
Spot checks show authorization matches task requirements, and evaluation and temporary identities have been explicitly narrowed
The six categories of high risk actions each have a blocking or confirmation rule
Determination is before execution and the conventions at the three places are consistent, and the default when determination is unavailable is to deny
Secrets are in centralized custody, code and logs have no plaintext, and rotation has records
Exfiltration channels are registered one by one, and exfiltration through an unregistered channel is intercepted
In special periods write actions stop automatically or are escalated for confirmation, with drills or actual results
No borrowed credential is used to handle real business, and credentials and actions can be corresponded in the logs
Scalable actions have rate and total quantity limits and abnormality alerts
The ledger is re-verified on a cycle, and idle and excess authorizations have been recovered and have retained records
For any sampled historical request, the model version, injection sources, calls, and output can be assembled
Records are only added to and not changed, corrections appear as appended entries, and the retention period is documented
The main scenarios have continuous monitoring, and no new version went live during a period when monitoring had stopped
Periodic evaluation uses a registered baseline, and version breakpoints are annotated
Alerts are graded, have claiming and escalation, handling retains records, and there is no natural falling silent
Credential and cost anomalies have monitoring, and after triggering there is a record of a rate limiting or freezing action
The monitored subject has no permission or path to rewrite, suspend, or bypass monitoring
Incident registration is complete, and review includes the primary failure layer and strengthening actions on account
Interception records are looked back at periodically, and a zero interception system has a special check record
Figures disclosed to the outside can point back to record fields, and the delay convention annotates the segment
